name: DropdownMenu
description: A contextual menu that displays a list of actions or options triggered by a button press. Built on @radix-ui/react-dropdown-menu with animated open/close transitions (fade, zoom, slide). Supports standard items, checkbox items, radio items, sub-menus, labels, separators, and keyboard shortcut hints. Content is portaled and auto-constrained to available viewport height.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state of the dropdown menu.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: The default open state when uncontrolled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Event handler called when the open state changes.

props.name: modal
props.description: Whether the dropdown blocks interaction with the rest of the page when open.

props.name: dir
props.description: Reading direction for the menu.

subComponents.name: DropdownMenuTrigger
subComponents.description: The button that toggles the dropdown menu open/closed.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Merge props onto the child element instead of rendering a default button.

subComponents.name: DropdownMenuContent
subComponents.description: The popover container for menu items. Portaled to document.body. Styled with border, bg-popover, rounded-md, shadow-md. Max height is constrained to --radix-dropdown-menu-content-available-height. Includes directional slide-in animations.

props.name: sideOffset
props.description: Distance in pixels from the trigger.

props.name: side
props.description: The preferred side to position the menu relative to the trigger.

props.name: align
props.description: Alignment relative to the trigger.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes.

subComponents.name: DropdownMenuItem
subComponents.description: A standard menu action item. Highlights with bg-accent on focus. Supports an inset prop for left-padding alignment with checkbox/radio items.

props.name: inset
props.description: When true, adds pl-8 left padding to align with checkbox/radio items.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the item.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Callback when the item is selected.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes.

subComponents.name: DropdownMenuCheckboxItem
subComponents.description: A menu item that can be toggled on/off. Displays a Check icon indicator when checked. Has pl-8 padding to accommodate the indicator.

props.name: checked
props.description: The checked state of the item.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: Callback when the checked state changes.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the item.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes.

subComponents.name: DropdownMenuRadioGroup
subComponents.description: Groups radio items together so only one can be selected at a time.

props.name: value
props.description: The value of the currently selected radio item.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Callback when the selected radio item changes.

subComponents.name: DropdownMenuRadioItem
subComponents.description: A radio-selectable menu item. Displays a filled Circle icon indicator when selected. Has pl-8 padding to accommodate the indicator.

props.name: value
props.description: The unique value for this radio item.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the item.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes.

subComponents.name: DropdownMenuLabel
subComponents.description: A non-interactive label for a group of items. Styled as text-sm font-semibold. Supports inset prop.

props.name: inset
props.description: When true, adds pl-8 left padding.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes.

subComponents.name: DropdownMenuSeparator
subComponents.description: A visual separator line between menu sections. Renders as a 1px horizontal line with bg-muted.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes.

subComponents.name: DropdownMenuShortcut
subComponents.description: Displays a keyboard shortcut hint aligned to the right of a menu item. Styled as text-xs tracking-widest at 60% opacity.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes.

props.name: children
props.description: The shortcut text.

subComponents.name: DropdownMenuGroup
subComponents.description: Groups related menu items together for semantic grouping.

props.name: container
props.description: The container to portal into.

subComponents.name: DropdownMenuSub
subComponents.description: Wraps a sub-menu (nested menu). Contains DropdownMenuSubTrigger and DropdownMenuSubContent.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state of the sub-menu.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Default open state.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Callback when the sub-menu open state changes.

subComponents.name: DropdownMenuSubTrigger
subComponents.description: The item that opens a sub-menu on hover/focus. Displays a ChevronRight icon on the right side. Supports inset prop.

props.name: inset
props.description: When true, adds pl-8 left padding.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes.

subComponents.name: DropdownMenuSubContent
subComponents.description: The popover content for a sub-menu. Styled similarly to DropdownMenuContent with shadow-lg and directional animations. Uses origin-[--radix-dropdown-menu-content-transform-origin] for natural-looking transitions.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes.

accessibility.role: Uses role='menu' on the content, role='menuitem' on items, role='menuitemcheckbox' on checkbox items, and role='menuitemradio' on radio items. The trigger has aria-haspopup='menu'.
accessibility.keyboard: Arrow Down/Up navigates between items. Arrow Right opens a sub-menu. Arrow Left closes a sub-menu. Enter/Space selects an item. Escape closes the menu (returning focus to trigger). Type-ahead is supported for quick item selection.
accessibility.aria: aria-expanded on the trigger reflects open state. aria-checked on checkbox/radio items reflects selection. aria-disabled on disabled items. aria-controls on trigger references the content id.
accessibility.notes: Follows the WAI-ARIA Menu Pattern. Focus is managed automatically by Radix. The menu closes on item selection by default (call event.preventDefault() in onSelect to keep it open).
